name: Pelonomi Moiloa
bio: Pelonomi Moiloa is co-founder and chief executive officer of Lelapa AI, a Johannesburg company building language technology for African languages. Lelapa's products include the Vulavula speech and text service and InkubaLM, a small multilingual language model for African languages. Moiloa was named to TIME's list of the 100 most influential people in AI.
known_for: CEO and co-founder of Lelapa AI
